robotPuPro:
Make your Robot PU stronger and smarter with MakeCode blocks.
Robot PU can walk, dance, kick, jump, rest, explore, talk, and sing.
Control it with the gamepad or program custom behaviors.
robotPuPro.Mode: Robot PU behavior modes. Set the mode to switch between built-in behaviors.
robotPuPro.MusicLib.isABeat: check if it is a beat, compute music period, and update threshold
robotPuPro.PCB.motor: Control a DC motor. sp: -100 to 100.
robotPuPro.PCB.move: Move robot through state sequences. If moving down, return 0
robotPuPro.PCB.servoMove: Move all servos immediately to target state.
robotPuPro.PCB.servoStep: Move servo toward target with controlled speed.
robotPuPro.RoboVoice:
RoboVoice: converts any printable text to a pleasant robotic melody.
* Five algorithm layers:
1. A-pentatonic pitch set    — 13 pitches (A2→A5), no dissonant intervals possible.
2. Frequency-rank mapping    — top English letters map to A-family notes (440/880/220 Hz).
3. Markov pitch smoothing    — output = prev×0.6 + target×0.4, prevents jarring leaps.
4. Pitch contour             — vowels push pitch up; word boundaries pull it back to A4.
5. Duration weighting        — vowels 140ms, frequent consonants 80ms, stops 45ms.
* Full printable ASCII coverage:
Letters  → frequency-ranked pentatonic indices (see LETTER_INDEX).
Digits   → descending scale 0(high)…9(low) — robotic counting feel.
Punctuation → emotional effects:
'!' → sharp A5 accent + contour reset (excitement)
'?' → rising E4→A5 two-note glide (question intonation)
'.' → low A3 + full contour reset (sentence end / calm)
',' → short rest + slight dip (brief pause)
';' ':' → medium rest + neutral (softer pause)
'-' '—' → medium rest (em-dash / hyphen pause)
'\'' → tiny glide, no reset (contraction — keep flow)
'(' ')' → low G3 bracket tone (parenthetical aside)
'@' '#' '$' '%' '&' '*' → sharp high accent (special char emphasis)
'+' '=' → neutral mid C4 tone
' '     → rest + drift to A4 (word boundary)
Remaining printable ASCII → mid default tone (C4).
robotPuPro.RoboVoice.isMorse:
Detect whether a string is a morse code sequence.
A morse string contains only '.', '-', '/', ' ', and newline.
Must contain at least one '.' or '-' to qualify.
robotPuPro.RoboVoice.morse:
Play a morse code string using ITU-standard timing ratios.
* Timing (1 unit = unitMs, default 80ms):
'.'  dit  → A5 tone for 1 unit
'-'  dah  → A5 tone for 3 units
(between symbols in same letter) → 1 unit rest
'/'  or single ' ' (letter gap) → 3 unit rest
'  ' double space (word gap)    → 7 unit rest
* Example: "... --- ..." plays SOS.
Example: ".--.--.".   plays a pattern directly.
* @param code  Morse string of '.', '-', '/', ' ' characters.
robotPuPro.RoboVoice.morse|param|unitMs: Duration of one dit in milliseconds (default 80).
robotPuPro.RoboVoice.reset: Reset pitch state to neutral A4 (call before a new unrelated utterance).
robotPuPro.RoboVoice.say:
Speak text as a pleasant robotic melody.
Every printable ASCII character produces a musical event.
Plays synchronously (blocks until complete).
robotPuPro.RoboVoice.speak:
Smart dispatcher: plays morse if the text looks like a morse sequence,
otherwise plays it as a melodic speech utterance via say().
* @param text  Any string — morse (e.g. "... --- ...") or natural language.
robotPuPro.RoboVoice.speak|param|unitMs: Morse dit duration in ms (ignored for non-morse text).
robotPuPro.RoboVoice.toMorse:
Translate a plain text string into ITU morse code notation.
* Output format:
- Letters/digits are encoded as sequences of '.' and '-'.
- Codes within a word are separated by a single space.
- Words are separated by '  ' (double space).
- Unrecognised characters are silently skipped.
* Example:
toMorse("SOS")        → "... --- ..."
toMorse("Hello")      → ".... . .-.. .-.. ---"
toMorse("Hi 73")      → ".... ..  --... ...--"
* @param text  Plain text to encode (case-insensitive).
@returns     Morse code string ready to pass to morse() or talk().
robotPuPro.RobotPu:
RobotPu Class for MakeCode
Optimized with internal PCB and Parameters instances.
robotPuPro.RobotPu.checkWakeup:
Monitors sensors to determine if the robot should exit sleep mode.
@returns 1 if the robot should wake up, 0 otherwise.
robotPuPro.RobotPu.dance: Makes the robot dance with self-balance based on sound analysis.
robotPuPro.RobotPu.explore:
Autonomous exploration with obstacle point-cloud mapping.
Updates the distance array and adjusts movement parameters.
robotPuPro.RobotPu.fall:
Handles the robot's behavior when it has fallen and cannot recover.
Ported from fall() in Python.
robotPuPro.RobotPu.fetal:
Set the robot to a compact fetal position for protection or power saving.
Ported from fetal() in Python.
robotPuPro.RobotPu.getBwdMaxSpeed: Returns the backward max speed scalar.
robotPuPro.RobotPu.getFwdMaxSpeed: Returns the forward max speed scalar.
robotPuPro.RobotPu.getTurnFromSonar:
Map sonar distance readings to a steering direction for auto-pilot.


@returns Steering direction between -1.0 (left) and 1.0 (right)
robotPuPro.RobotPu.greet:
Makes the robot greet using text-to-speech.
The robot will speak its serial number and name.
robotPuPro.RobotPu.incrGroupId: Adjusts the radio group ID and updates the hardware settings.
robotPuPro.RobotPu.incrGroupId|param|i: The amount to adjust the group ID by (positive or negative).
robotPuPro.RobotPu.joystick:
Handles manual movement and stance control from a remote.
Ported from joystick() in Python.
robotPuPro.RobotPu.jump:
Executes a specific jumping sequence and manages the auxiliary jump servo.
Ported from jump() in Python.
robotPuPro.RobotPu.kick:
Executes a kick by accelerating the forward walking gait.
Returns to joystick mode when the kick completes at specific gait positions.
robotPuPro.RobotPu.sendStatusCode: Publishes a status or error code via radio.
robotPuPro.RobotPu.setBwdMaxSpeed: Sets the backward max speed scalar.
robotPuPro.RobotPu.setFwdMaxSpeed: Sets the forward max speed scalar.
robotPuPro.RobotPu.setGroupId: Set the radio group ID and updates the hardware settings.
robotPuPro.RobotPu.setGroupId|param|chan: The channel to set the radio group ID to.
robotPuPro.RobotPu.sideStep:
Executes a side-stepping (lateral) movement.


Executes a side-stepping movement using specific state indices.
robotPuPro.RobotPu.sideStep|param|di: Directional bias: positive for right, negative for left.
robotPuPro.RobotPu.sing: Sing a note sequence string using the built-in music engine.
robotPuPro.RobotPu.sing|param|s: The note sequence string, e.g. "C5 D E F G".
robotPuPro.RobotPu.sleepMode:
Puts the robot into a low-power standby mode.
Ported from sleep() in Python.
robotPuPro.RobotPu.stand:
Set the robot to a neutral standing position.
Ported from stand() in Python.
robotPuPro.RobotPu.stateMachine:
Main state machine for robot behavior control.
Processes the current state (gst) and executes the corresponding behavior.
robotPuPro.RobotPu.updateStates:
Update robot states based on sensor inputs.
Ported from set_states() in Python.
robotPuPro.RobotPu.walk: Triggers the balanced walking gait. Compute odometry for SLAM
robotPuPro.RobotPu.walkByCompass: Walks to a target compass heading while maintaining obstacle avoidance.
robotPuPro.RobotPu.walk|param|sp: Speed (positive for forward, negative for backward)
robotPuPro.ServoJoint: Robot PU servo joints. Each joint corresponds to one servo motor on the robot body.
robotPuPro.bodyPitch: Return the current body pitch angle in degrees. Positive means leaning forward.
robotPuPro.bodyRoll: Return the current body roll angle in degrees. Positive means tilting to the right.
robotPuPro.calibrate: Move to the calibration pose and flash the eyes. Useful after changing servo trim values.
robotPuPro.changeChannel: Change the radio channel by a given amount. Wraps around between 0 and 255.
robotPuPro.changeChannel|param|delta: amount to change the channel by, eg: 1
robotPuPro.channel: Current radio channel (0..255). Both Robot PU and the gamepad must use the same channel to communicate.
robotPuPro.dance: Dance to music using the microphone to detect the beat. Call repeatedly in a loop.
robotPuPro.explore: Explore autonomously using the sonar sensor to avoid obstacles. Call repeatedly in a loop.
robotPuPro.eyeBrightness: The maximum brightness of Robot PU's eye LEDs (0 to 1).
robotPuPro.frontDistanceArray: Return the front distance array in centimeters. Items: left, front-left, front, front-right, right. Call sonar scan first to update the values.
robotPuPro.greet: Robot PU introduces itself by speaking its name and serial number.
robotPuPro.incrementControlOffsets: Increment servo control offsets smoothly. Each value is multiplied by gain and added to the current offset.
robotPuPro.incrementControlOffsets|param: multiplier applied to each value before adding, eg: 1
array of servo joint indices to increment offsets for
array of offset increments in degrees
robotPuPro.jump: Perform a jump sequence. Call repeatedly in a loop to complete the jump.
robotPuPro.kick: Perform a kick motion. Call repeatedly in a loop to complete the kick.
robotPuPro.leftEyeBright: Set the left eye LED brightness.
robotPuPro.locationArray: Return Robot PU's estimated location as [x, y, heading]. x and y are in millimeters, heading is in degrees.
robotPuPro.mode: The current behavior mode Robot PU is running.
robotPuPro.morse:
Play a morse code string using ITU-standard timing.
Use '.' for dit, '-' for dah, ' ' to separate letters, '  ' (double space) to separate words, '/' as an alternative letter separator.
robotPuPro.morseText:
Translate plain text to morse code and play it immediately.
Combines the translate and morse blocks in one step.
robotPuPro.morseText|param|text: plain text to translate and play as morse, eg: "Hello"
robotPuPro.morseText|param|unitMs: duration of one dit in milliseconds, eg: 80
robotPuPro.morse|param|code: morse code string to play, eg: "... --- ..."
robotPuPro.morse|param|unitMs: duration of one dit in milliseconds, eg: 80
robotPuPro.moveServos:
Move multiple servos toward target angles simultaneously, with separate synchronous and asynchronous servo groups.
Synchronous servos block until they arrive; asynchronous servos move in the background.
robotPuPro.moveServos|param|asyncList: array of servo joint indices that move in the background
robotPuPro.moveServos|param|asyncSpeedGa: speed multiplier for the asynchronous group, eg: 1
robotPuPro.moveServos|param|speeds: array of 10 maximum step sizes in degrees per call (one per servo joint)
robotPuPro.moveServos|param|syncList: array of servo joint indices that must arrive before this function returns true
robotPuPro.moveServos|param|syncSpeedGai: speed multiplier for the synchronous group, eg: 1
robotPuPro.moveServos|param|targets: array of 10 target angles (one per servo joint, 0 to 180 degrees)
robotPuPro.musicTempo: Return the live music tempo detected from the microphone in beats per minute.
robotPuPro.playToneSequenceMs: Play a sequence of tones using arrays of frequencies in Hz and durations in milliseconds. Use frequency 0 for a rest.
robotPuPro.playToneSequenceMs|param|dura: array of tone durations in milliseconds, eg: [100, 100, 200]
robotPuPro.playToneSequenceMs|param|freq: array of tone frequencies in Hz, use 0 for a rest, eg: [440, 550, 660]
robotPuPro.readConfig: Load saved robot configuration from flash storage, including servo trim values and radio channel.
robotPuPro.resetOdom: Reset the odometry so Robot PU's position is (0, 0) and heading is 0 degrees (north).
robotPuPro.rest: Rest in a balanced idle pose. Reacts subtly to sound.
robotPuPro.rightEyeBright: Set the right eye LED brightness.
robotPuPro.runKeyValueCommand:
Execute a key/value command received over radio. Use this inside a radio.onReceivedValue handler.
Supported keys: #puspeed (forward/back), #puturn (left/right), #puroll (head yaw), #pupitch (head pitch), #puB (behavior).
robotPuPro.runKeyValueCommand|param|key: the command key received from radio, eg: "#puspeed"
robotPuPro.runKeyValueCommand|param|valu: the command value received from radio, eg: 1
robotPuPro.runStringCommand:
Execute a string command received over radio. Use this inside a radio.onReceivedString handler.
Supported commands: #put<text> (speak), #pus<song> (sing), #puhi<name> (greet friend), #pun<name> (set robot name).
robotPuPro.runStringCommand|param|comman: the command string received from radio, eg: "#putHello!"
robotPuPro.saveServoTrimCalibration: Save the current servo trim values to flash storage. Saved trims are restored automatically on next boot.
robotPuPro.servo: Move a servo joint directly to an angle.
robotPuPro.servoControls: Return the servo control output angles array. Items: left foot, left leg, right foot, right leg, head yaw, head pitch, left shoulder, right shoulder, left arm, right arm.
robotPuPro.servoStep: Move a servo joint toward a target angle one step at a time, for smooth motion.
robotPuPro.servoStepStatus: Move a servo joint toward a target angle one step at a time. Returns 1 while moving, 0 when arrived.
robotPuPro.servoStepStatus|param|joint: the servo joint to move, eg: robotPuPro.ServoJoint.HeadYaw
robotPuPro.servoStepStatus|param|stepSiz: maximum degrees to move per call, eg: 2
robotPuPro.servoStepStatus|param|target: target angle from 0 to 180 degrees, eg: 90
robotPuPro.servoStep|param|joint: the servo joint to move, eg: robotPuPro.ServoJoint.HeadYaw
robotPuPro.servoStep|param|stepSize: maximum degrees to move per call, eg: 2
robotPuPro.servoStep|param|target: target angle from 0 to 180 degrees, eg: 90
robotPuPro.servoTargets: Return the servo target angles array. Items: left foot, left leg, right foot, right leg, head yaw, head pitch, left shoulder, right shoulder, left arm, right arm.
robotPuPro.servoTrims: Return the servo trim offsets array. Items: left foot, left leg, right foot, right leg, head yaw, head pitch, left shoulder, right shoulder, left arm, right arm.
robotPuPro.servo|param|angle: target angle from 0 to 180 degrees, eg: 90
robotPuPro.servo|param|joint: the servo joint to move, eg: robotPuPro.ServoJoint.HeadYaw
robotPuPro.setChannel: Set the radio channel (0..255). Both Robot PU and the gamepad must use the same channel.
robotPuPro.setControlOffsets: Set servo control offsets for feedback or feedforward control. Each value is an angle offset added to the servo motion target.
robotPuPro.setControlOffsets|param|index: array of servo joint indices to set offsets for
robotPuPro.setControlOffsets|param|value: array of angle offsets in degrees to apply to each indexed servo
robotPuPro.setEyeBrightness: Set the maximum brightness of Robot PU's eye LEDs.
robotPuPro.setMode: Set Robot PU's behavior mode directly.
robotPuPro.setMode|param|mode: the behavior mode to switch to, eg: robotPuPro.Mode.Walk
robotPuPro.setServoTrim: Set a servo trim offset to correct physical assembly differences. The value is added to the servo target angle.
robotPuPro.setServoTrim|param|joint: the servo joint to trim, eg: robotPuPro.ServoJoint.LeftFoot
robotPuPro.setWalkSpeedRange: Set the walk speed range. The minimum maps to full backward speed, the maximum maps to full forward speed.
robotPuPro.sideStep|param|direction: direction to step: -1 for left, 1 for right, eg: -1
robotPuPro.sing:
Sing a musical note sequence using the built-in music engine.
Notes are written as letter names (A-G) with optional octave number, separated by spaces. Use '-' for a rest.
robotPuPro.sing|param|song: the note sequence string to sing, eg: "C5 B G - E F E G "
robotPuPro.sonarDistanceCm: Return the current sonar distance reading in centimeters. Returns a large value if nothing is detected.
robotPuPro.sonarScan: Take one sonar reading and update the internal front distance array. Call this before reading the front distance array.
robotPuPro.talk: Speak text aloud as a melodic robotic voice. If the text contains only morse characters (. - / space) it is played as morse code instead.
robotPuPro.talk|param|text: the text to speak or morse code string, eg: "Hello!"
robotPuPro.toMorse:
Translate plain text into a morse code string using the ITU morse alphabet.
The returned string can be passed to the morse block or displayed on the LED matrix.
robotPuPro.toggleServoTrim: Toggle servo trim calibration mode on or off. Use the gamepad to select and adjust each servo while in calibration mode.
robotPuPro.walk: Walk with a given speed and turn bias. Call repeatedly in a loop to keep walking.
robotPuPro.walkByCompass: Walk toward a target compass heading while avoiding obstacles. Call repeatedly in a loop.
robotPuPro.walkByCompassPID:
Walk toward a target compass heading using PID (Proportional-Integral-Derivative) control while avoiding obstacles.
PID tuning: increase proportional gain for faster response, add integral gain to correct steady-state error, add derivative gain to reduce overshoot.
robotPuPro.walkByCompassPID|param|headin: target compass heading in degrees (0 = north, 90 = east), eg: 0
robotPuPro.walkByCompass|param|headingDe: target compass heading in degrees (0 = north, 90 = east), eg: 0
robotPuPro.walk|param|speed: walking speed from -5 (full backward) to 5 (full forward), eg: 2
robotPuPro.walk|param|turn: turn bias from -1 (full left) to 1 (full right), 0 is straight, eg: 0
robotPuPro.writeConfig: Save current robot configuration to flash storage, including servo trim values and radio channel.
robotPuPro.isWalkStepDone: Return true when the last walk step completed.
robotPuPro.isExploreDone: Return true when the last explore step completed.
robotPuPro.isSideStepDone: Return true when the last side step completed.
robotPuPro.isDanceDone: Return true when the last dance move completed.
robotPuPro.isKickDone: Return true when the last kick completed.
robotPuPro.isJumpDone: Return true when the last jump completed.
robotPuPro.isRestDone: Return true when the last rest cycle completed.
robotPuPro.isStandDone: Return true when the robot reached the standing position.
